description: Regression registry. Every defect confirmed on emjaywellness.com.au gets an entry here so it can never silently return. Add a new entry the moment a defect is found; never delete an entry after it is fixed.

defects.title: Site must expose a reachable XML sitemap
robots.txt must not disallow the whole site
No page may be simultaneously in the sitemap and noindex
Homepage must return 200 with no redirect hop
Every page must have exactly one H1
No empty headings anywhere on the site
No JavaScript console errors on any page
No horizontal overflow at 390px viewport
Every page declares a self-referencing canonical
No internal link may point at a redirecting URL
defects.source: QA brief 2026-08 — redirect chains / internal linking

defects.title: Service pages must not offer only a generic booking link
defects.source: QA brief 2026-08 — generic booking links where specific intent exists

defects.title: No broken internal or external links
defects.source: QA brief 2026-08 — broken links and HTTP errors

defects.title: No missing or duplicate <title> across the site
No missing or duplicate meta descriptions across the site
All content images carry alt text
No orphan pages (in sitemap, zero internal inbound links)
Structured data parses and carries required properties
Enquiry/booking forms are structurally complete and labelled
defects.note: Structure only. The suite never submits a form on the live site.
